FAQ

SEO Questions, Answered

Clear answers before you choose an audit or monthly package.

Is the basic SEO audit really free?+
Yes. The basic audit is a quick first check to identify major issues and opportunities. It helps us understand whether your website is a good fit for SEO work.
What makes the $99 deep audit different?+
The full deep audit is more detailed. It reviews technical issues, on-page SEO, keyword gaps, competitor direction, local SEO where relevant, and gives a practical action plan.
How long does SEO take to show results?+
SEO is usually a 3–6 month process for meaningful movement. The timeline depends on your website condition, competition, content quality, and how much work is needed.
Do you guarantee first position on Google?+
No serious SEO agency can honestly guarantee a specific ranking. We focus on ethical SEO, measurable improvements, better pages, and clear monthly progress.
Can you do local SEO for one city or multiple locations?+
Yes. We can plan local pages, Google Business Profile direction, service-area targeting, and location-based content for one city or multiple locations.
Do monthly packages include blog posts?+
Search Growth includes 2 SEO blog posts per month, and Search Authority includes 4 SEO blog posts per month. Search Launch focuses mainly on the SEO foundation.
Can I start with audit only?+
Yes. You can start with the free basic audit or the $99 deep audit. Monthly SEO is optional after you review the findings and recommendations.
Will I get reports?+
Yes. Monthly packages include simple reporting showing work completed, keyword movement, traffic signals, key issues, and next actions.
